name: Mega Menu for Drupal 9/10
description: This powerful Drupal module helps you create custom menu, video and Drupal Blocks.
project_description:
We Mega Menu is a powerful and flexible menu management module built for Drupal 8 and 9, designed for both personal use and sharing with the community. Inspired by the TB Megamenu for Drupal 7 , this module takes navigation to the next level by incorporating modern features and enhancements.

 We Mega Menu enables developers and site builders to create sophisticated, responsive navigation menus with ease. It offers extensive customization options, such as multiple layout styles, animation effects, and advanced configuration settings, allowing users to tailor their menus to their unique branding needs. With a drag-and-drop interface and seamless integration into Drupal themes, it ensures both functionality and ease of use.

 Detailed documentation is available to assist users at every step, find the detailed guide here . Developed by WeebPal - Drupal Development Company , this module represents our commitment to innovation and contribution to the Drupal community.
